segments.name: Exploration and production
segments.description: Explores, develops and produces natural gas, NGLs and oil, primarily in the Appalachian Basin in the United States.
segments.evidence: We have three reportable segments: exploration and production, our equity method investment in Antero Midstream and marketing.

segments.name: Equity method investment in Antero Midstream
segments.description: Holds an equity method investment in Antero Midstream, which provides midstream services to the company's operations.
segments.evidence: Therefore, we operate in the following reportable segments: (i) the exploration, development and production of natural gas, NGLs and oil ("exploration and production"); (ii) midstream services through our equity method investment in Antero Midstream ("equity method investment in Antero Midstream") and (iii) marketing of excess firm transportation capacity ("marketing").

segments.name: Marketing
segments.description: Markets the company's excess firm transportation capacity on major pipelines.
segments.evidence: Therefore, we operate in the following reportable segments: (i) the exploration, development and production of natural gas, NGLs and oil ("exploration and production"); (ii) midstream services through our equity method investment in Antero Midstream ("equity method investment in Antero Midstream") and (iii) marketing of excess firm transportation capacity ("marketing").

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling the natural gas, NGLs and oil it produces to customers, with prices significantly impacting revenues and cash flows.
revenueModel.evidence: Prices for natural gas, NGLs and oil that we produce significantly impact our revenues and cash flows.

changes.text: In 2025, the company agreed to sell substantially all of its Utica Shale oil and gas assets in Ohio, expected to close in February 2026.
changes.evidence: On December 5, 2025, we entered into a definitive agreement with two third-party buyers (collectively, the "Buyer Parties") to sell substantially all of our Utica Shale oil and gas assets (the "Utica Shale Properties") for aggregate cash consideration of $800 million, subject to the terms and conditions thereof.
